message: No detected input validation: The only input check is an assert that the method string is in ALLOWED_METHODS; there are no schema, dtype, shape, or value-range validations on the downloaded image data or dataset structure.

No detected untrusted source handling: The _download method fetches a tarball via wget using a hardcoded URL with no checksum verification, signature validation, or any other integrity check on the downloaded file.

No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is used anywhere in the data preparation or training pipeline.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code downloads and extracts data directly without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples before use.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained weights via `timm.create_model(..., pretrained=True)` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned model revision to verify integrity.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before or during the fit() calls.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or applied during training.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or any FGSM/PGD perturbations anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train and test datasets are loaded separately via MVTecDataset, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no formal holdout isolation enforcement, and only two correlated metrics (image_rocauc and pixel_rocauc) are used with no independent verification mechanism.

No detected input sanitization: The code only validates the method name via an assert and dataset name via a dict lookup; there are no shape, range, or type checks on image tensors before they are passed to the model.

No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (z_score, fmap, rocauc values) are used directly without any NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity validation before being stored or returned.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer-vision anomaly detection pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
